ai.title: Decision language models as affordable and rapid alternatives to LLM judges of clinical generative AI
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.28826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated judges of clinical artificial intelligence (AI) outputs are necessary, but large language model (LLM) judges are costly and slow at scale. We compared Jev, a decision language model that returns structured judgments, with frontier and open-weight LLM judges in four use cases. On 118 pediatric answers, Jev's agreement with physicians' ordinal quality ratings (Gwet's AC2 0.50; expected score 0.53) matched or exceeded that of seven of 12 LLM judges, including frontier models, Claude Opus 5.5 (0.49) and GPT-6 (0.38). On physician-graded binary HealthBench criteria, Jev matched or exceeded four of six LLM judges. On MedHELM's open-ended tasks, Jev's agreement with a three-LLM jury approached or exceeded the jurors' internal agreement. On HealthBench Professional, Jev matched the benchmark's reference judge, GPT-5.4, on 91% of criteria (other judges, 91-93%). Frontier judges cost 73-294 times more than Jev and took 7-57 times longer. Jev may enable efficient clinical AI evaluation at scale.
ai.summary: Automated judges of clinical artificial intelligence (AI) outputs are necessary, but large language model (LLM) judges are costly and slow at scale.

ai.title: Commit or Abstain? System One Decision Models, LLMs, and Missing Legal Authority
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.29961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law. System One decision models are built on large language models but, instead of generating text, return a calibrated probability for each option. This suits the verification of legal authority, where the question is closed: a given holding, or none of them. We test whether such models abstain when the correct authority is missing. We extend CaseHOLD with an abstention condition in which the correct holding is replaced in 1,670 of 5,314 items, and compare four decision models with six generative LLMs. When no option is correct, generative LLMs still pick one in 38-86% of items; the most cautious decision model does so in 30%. On standard CaseHOLD, a decision model matches the best generative LLM (88.1% vs. 88.2%) at 1/55 of the cost. Accepting that LLM's answer only when a decision model agrees halves its wrong citations, and distilling a decision model's probabilities into Qwen3-8B, without labels, yields a well-calibrated local model. Legal AI should be judged by its wrong citations, not by accuracy alone.
ai.summary: Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law.

ai.title: Behavior Beyond Text: Evaluating Refusal Transfer Failure in LLM Agents
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.28982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-calling agents, their safety evaluations still focus primarily on their ability to refuse harmful requests in text. We investigate whether the refusal behavior in text transfers to tool use. We construct a benchmark of 2,304 prompts across four domains, consisting of matched triplets that present the same harmful or benign request in text-only, standard tool-enabled, and adversarially framed tool-enabled settings. We then assess tool-call safety using 20 predefined forbidden actions. Testing five models of varying sizes and families, we find that requests refused in text frequently result in unsafe tool calls. Under standard tool-enabled prompting, this divergence occurs for 10-52 percent of harmful requests refused in chat. To mechanistically investigate this gap, we identify a refusal-associated direction in the residual stream of each of the five models. We find that in tool-enabled contexts, the activations along this direction decrease in four of five models. Furthermore, lower activation predicts unsafe tool calls across all five models (AUC 0.76-0.86). However, restoring the signal to the respective text-only value through activation patching only prevents a subset of unsafe calls, primarily by suppressing tool use rather than by producing safer calls. ai.title: Keeping Time vs. Understanding Time: Neither Alone Explains Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.29507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.

ai.title: Where Do LLMs Learn to Recommend AI?
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.29785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options. We ask where this tendency comes from by comparing models before and after fine-tuning and by varying how questions are asked. First, pretrained models already include explicit AI/ML terms in the recommendations of 27% of their responses, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so in 59%. Second, fine-tuning models ourselves shows that this rise is not inevitable: general instruction tuning leaves the rate unchanged, but removing the 7% of instruction examples that concern AI cuts it by 14 percentage points, below the level of the pretrained models it starts from. Data rewarding helpfulness raise it by 9 points, while data ranked by the preferences of diverse simulated users lower it by 9. Finally, with models held fixed, asking for the "best" option or for what to do "right now" raises the rate by 8 and 18 points, whereas telling the model it is an AI advisor adds 4. Overall, the tendency starts in pretraining, and what models learn afterward, together with how a question is phrased, decides how strongly it appears.
ai.summary: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options.

ai.title: Every Part Has Its Role: Part-of-Speech Effects in LLM Post-Training
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2610.29843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are typically trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting specific tokens rather than explicitly accounting for the semantic similarities between different words or expressions. Prior work has addressed this limitation by augmenting training data with minimally varying sentences that replace a target word with conceptually related alternatives, e.g., "The tired coach ran home" $\rightarrow$ {"The tired trainer ran home", "The tired instructor ran home", ...}. Such concept augmentation improves performance, but it remains unclear whether its effectiveness depends on where in the sentence the concept is expressed. We reproduce and extend prior work $\textit{beyond nouns}$ to verbs and adjectives, asking whether the part of speech (POS) carrying the concept signal affects perplexity and downstream performance. We find different patterns across evaluation settings: concept augmentation improves perplexity most consistently on news, independent of the POS used, whereas verbs provide the most reliable downstream gains. Despite these behavioral differences, representational analyses using CKA and linear probing show that the conditions yielding the largest downstream gains are not necessarily those that most alter the model's internal representations. ai.title: Critical Minerals: BLM Should Ensure Individuals and Businesses Meet Citizenship Requirements for Hardrock Mining Claims
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found The Department of the Interior’s Bureau of Land Management (BLM) administers mining claims that grant the exclusive right to extract critical and other hardrock minerals from most federal lands. U.S. mining laws include citizenship requirements for individuals and business entities holding such claims, known as mining claimants. Under these laws, mining claimants generally must be U.S. citizens, which can include individuals as well as business entities incorporated in a U.S. state or territory. Foreign entities are not qualified to be claimants, but their subsidiaries can hold claims if they are incorporated in the U.S. Mining claimants are not required to disclose to BLM if they are a subsidiary of another entity, foreign or domestic, and they do not have to provide information on any foreign investment they may receive. Under BLM’s regulations and guidance, the agency collects basic identifying information from individuals and business entities holding mining claims. However, BLM generally does not collect citizenship information and does not document if mining claimants meet the U.S. citizenship requirements. In addition, BLM officials said the agency rarely verifies the citizenship of mining claimants. As a result, BLM generally does not know whether mining claimants are qualified to hold mining claims. ai.title: Critical Minerals: Limited Available Information on the Full Extent of Foreign Investment in Mining on Federal Lands
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found The U.S critical mineral supply chain faces numerous constraints, including the need for substantial capital investment and limited domestic processing capacity. The U.S. exports large quantities of domestically extracted ore to Canada, Mexico, and China, among other countries. Copper Mine on Federal Lands The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and the Forest Service oversee hardrock mines on federal land. As of February 2026, there were 632 approved hardrock mining plans of operation on federal land. The 1872 Mining Law generally requires mining claimants to be U.S. citizens or business entities incorporated in the U.S. Foreign businesses can meet this requirement by having a U.S. subsidiary serve as the claimant. While there is limited available information on the full extent of foreign investment in mining on federal lands and parent-subsidiary relationships, GAO reviewed ownership information of 43 claimants and operators associated with critical mineral mines on federal lands. GAO determined ownership for 32 of those companies and found that 14 were subsidiaries of foreign entities. GAO found that none of the 14 had Chinese-owned parent companies, but in at least two cases, Chinese entities had financial interest in the foreign parent companies. ai.title: Service Member Records: DOD Needs to Address Improper and Delayed Releasing of Personnel and Health Information
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found Service members can accrue a large volume of personnel and health records during their military careers. The custodians of these records are the Department of Defense (DOD) and the Department of Veterans Affairs. DOD and the military services developed policies and procedures to properly adhere to federal laws for safeguarding records and timely processing records requests. However, the risk of breaches and delays exists. For example, GAO covertly tested 26 requests for records from DOD; of the 18 processed requests, one was improperly released and did not redact personally identifiable information. Examples of Breaches of Military Records Among Record Custodians Personnel records. The military services have procedures intended to safeguard records, such as redacting personally identifiable information. However, of the thousands of requests received during fiscal years 2021 through 2025, the services reported 49 breaches. The Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requires agencies to respond to requests within 20 business days, and Privacy Act requests are generally processed within 20 business days. According to military service officials, staffing limitations across the military services contribute to challenges with the proper and timely processing of records requests. For example, during the time of GAO’s review, the Navy had one employee processing FOIA requests, which officials stated contributed to an increased average processing time from 1.6 to 55.5 days.
ai.summary: What GAO Found Service members can accrue a large volume of personnel and health records during their military careers.

trade.title: 海關積極參與APEC關務程序次級委員會，拓展國際關務合作空間
trade.source_name: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.via: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 財政部關務署表示，為掌握亞太地區關務發展趨勢，深化國際交流與合作，該署歷年均派員參與亞太經濟合作（APEC）關務程序次級委員會（SCCP）相關會議，會議中與各國代表積極互動交流，有助提升我國國際能見度及拓展國際關務合作空間。 關務署指出，本（115）年APEC SCCP會議聚焦於以人工智慧（AI）推動關務現代化、跨境電子商務通關與監管、海關與公私部門合作等議題，其中運用AI強化海關關務效能，儼然成為APEC各會員關務趨勢，期望藉由AI提升海關查緝效能及通關效率，但APEC會員亦相互提醒，應以審慎務實方式漸進式推進轉型或建構AI應用，並輔以第一線關員之專業經驗及細心觀察，更可發揮風險辨識及通關最大效益。我國近年亦積極導入AI輔助儀檢影像辨識系統，輔助關員判別毒品及肉品等違禁品；並建置「AI貨品歸屬稅則查詢系統」，協助商民更快速且精確查得貨品歸屬稅則號別，未來將持續關注本議題發展並與各會員合作，以務實並安全地運用AI在關務各領域。 此外，擴大中小企業參與優質企業（AEO）制度為近年SCCP關注之重要議題。我國於98年12月起推動AEO認證制度，已有逾900家企業取得認證。為響應APEC擴大中小微企業參與AEO制度之倡議，我國取消AEO進出口實績限制，鼓勵更多中小企業申請認證。此外，我國已與美、日等10國簽署AEO相互承認協議，透過國際合作促進貿易便捷及供應鏈安全。面對近年美國關稅政策變動所帶來的挑戰，AEO制度除有助於強化國際供應鏈安全與促進貿易便捷外，亦可降低企業行政成本，提升物流管理效率及出口競爭力。 關務署進一步表示，該署多次受邀於APEC SCCP相關研討會及海關與企業對話（ACBD）等場域，分享我國關務實務經驗與推動成果，議題涵蓋AI與數位技術應用、快遞貨物便捷通關與風險管理、擴大中小微企業參與全球貿易，以及推動性別平等與第一線女性工作者賦權等面向，均獲主辦方肯定及會員正面迴響，展現我國積極參與區域關務合作之成果。 關務署最後表示，海關將持續透過APEC相關場域汲取國際經驗，提升關務數位轉型與貿易便捷化成效，並積極分享關務優化措施與創新實踐，拓展國際關務合作空間。 新聞稿聯絡人：林科長 聯絡電話：（02）2550－5500分機1038

trade.title: 因應薔琵颱風來襲，海關為受災商民提供各項協助措施
trade.raw_summary: 財政部關務署表示，薔琵颱風即將來襲，可能帶來強風與豪雨，請民眾注意自身安全及備妥防災設施，並請各關秉持從寬、從速原則，提供受災商民減免關稅、救難物資免稅進口與快速通關及受損保稅物品除帳等協助措施。 關務署就上述協助措施補充說明如下： 1、進口貨物受損免稅：進口貨物起卸以後，驗放以前，因天災、事變或不可抗力之事由，而遭受損失或損壞致無價值者，得依關稅法第50條規定免徵關稅。已繳關稅且於提領前遭受天災事變致毀損者，亦得依關稅法第64條規定申請退稅。 2、救難物資免稅通關：政府機關為緊急救難自行進口或受贈的器材及物品，得依關稅法第49條第1項第17款規定免徵關稅。若未能及時取得中央主管機關（例如內政部或衛生福利部）核發之免稅文件，得依關稅法第18條規定先向海關辦理押款進口。 3、救濟物資先行通關後補文件：進口供災區救災與重建所需民生物資、醫療藥品及器材、工程機械與器（機）具及設備、環境清理消毒所用機具及藥劑等救濟物資，因時間急迫無法及時向衛生福利部申請免稅核准文件時，依救濟物資進口免稅辦法第3條第2項規定，可向進口地海關具結係供救災及重建之用，准予先行免稅進口。但申請人應於貨物放行之翌日起2個月內，依同法條第1項規定補辦申請程序。 4、受損保稅物品除帳：海關監管保稅工廠、保稅倉庫、物流中心、免稅商店、離島免稅購物商店、科學園區、科技產業園區、農業科技園區業者及自由貿易港區事業保稅貨物遭受災害而致損毀，得依各該法規申請核實除帳。 5、外銷品進口原料沖退稅期限可展延：因天災事變致無法如期辦理原料沖退稅，可依關稅法第63條第4項規定申請延期，最長1年。 6、快速通關單一窗口：各關機動成立救災物資快速通關單一窗口，以利救災物資快速通關。 關務署指出，商民如對於各項協助措施有不明瞭的地方，可就近洽詢當地海關，或於上班時間撥打免付費專線0800-005-055或下列各關緊急救難及救濟物資進口快速通關單一窗口電話向海關諮詢： （一）關務署基隆關 (02)24202951分機2102 （二）關務署臺北關 (03)3834265分機2260 （三）關務署臺中關 (04)26565101分機230 （四）關務署高雄關 (07)5628260 新聞稿聯絡人：李科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2570

trade.title: Critical Minerals: Limited Available Information on the Full Extent of Foreign Investment in Mining on Federal Lands
trade.raw_summary: What GAO Found The U.S critical mineral supply chain faces numerous constraints, including the need for substantial capital investment and limited domestic processing capacity. The U.S. exports large quantities of domestically extracted ore to Canada, Mexico, and China, among other countries. Copper Mine on Federal Lands The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and the Forest Service oversee hardrock mines on federal land. As of February 2026, there were 632 approved hardrock mining plans of operation on federal land. The 1872 Mining Law generally requires mining claimants to be U.S. citizens or business entities incorporated in the U.S. Foreign businesses can meet this requirement by having a U.S. subsidiary serve as the claimant. While there is limited available information on the full extent of foreign investment in mining on federal lands and parent-subsidiary relationships, GAO reviewed ownership information of 43 claimants and operators associated with critical mineral mines on federal lands. GAO determined ownership for 32 of those companies and found that 14 were subsidiaries of foreign entities. GAO found that none of the 14 had Chinese-owned parent companies, but in at least two cases, Chinese entities had financial interest in the foreign parent companies. world.raw_summary: PHP被曝存在严重安全漏洞后，引发黑客攻击数百万次，企业和政府机构纷纷紧急修补系统，欧洲多国政府网站及公共服务平台一度下线。网安公司指出，相关漏洞潜藏在PHP代码中多年，借助AI才得以发现。中国工信部敦促用户排查系统并升级至最新安全版本。
